Hi Carlos / Laura —

Thanks again for taking the time today — good to meet and hear more about Medica Health's roadmap. Quick recap from our end and a few clarifying asks so we can get the security intake moving quickly: 

Recap / what we heard:
- You plan to use Redwood for clinical routing / summarization in a closed VPC deployment.
- HIPAA considerations are in-scope, and you also need GDPR data residency controls for EU patients.
- You're interested in a vendor-hosted SIG/CAIQ prefill to accelerate procurement.

Clarifying questions (so we scope the right path):
1) SOC 2: Do you need a current SOC 2 Type II report before procurement, or is SOC 2 in-progress acceptable (we can provide our SOC 2 roadmap and control matrix)?
2) Questionnaire preference: Do you prefer a CAIQ (brief cloud controls) or the full SIG? We can do an accelerated CAIQ prefill and follow with SIG evidence, or go straight SIG if your procurement requires it.
3) Evidence asks: Which artifacts are highest priority for you initially (e.g., encryption-at-rest details, KMS key ownership, network diagrams, BAA language)?
4) Timeline & owner: Do you have a security owner who will coordinate uploads on your side? We usually ask for a named owner + a primary tech contact so we can route evidence questions.

Attached is our SIG prefill template (redwood_sig_prefill_20270718.pdf) and an evidence checklist we use to map asks to artifacts. If you can confirm SOC 2 requirement and preferred questionnaire by end of week, we’ll produce a tailored prefill and clear next steps.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm questionnaire preference + named owner (reply-all)
- We produce prefill + evidence checklist within 2 business days after confirmation
- Optionally schedule a 30-min technical sync to go through any controls that need deeper explanation

Thanks — happy to help accelerate.

— Soojin
